column1: # iQ-R device ranges, from the CPU startup manual's default parameter assignment.
# Two profiles because the R00/R01/R02 and R04..R120 groups differ in X/Y/M.
# NOTHING in this file has been verified on hardware. We have never had an iQ-R.
# The R and ZR rows say zero points, and that is not a mistake: an out-of-the-box iQ-R
# has no file register at all, so SH(NA)-080956ENG's own ZR16384 example fails on it.
# The exception message has to say that rather than "address out of range".

File register: ZERO POINTS on an out-of-the-box iQ-R. SH(NA)-080956ENG's own ZR16384 example fails on a default CPU. Allocate file register capacity in GX Works3, then hand the real range to profile.with_ranges().
File register (serial number access): ZERO POINTS by default, as for R. Radix disputed; see A-ZR-RADIX.
INFERRED: Direct access input. The iQ-R performance table does not list DX separately; it addresses the same I/O as X. No static range is validated for it.
INFERRED: Direct access output. The iQ-R performance table does not list DY separately; it addresses the same I/O as Y. No static range is validated for it.
INFERRED: Refresh data register. Size follows the module refresh setting, so there is no static range to validate. No static range is validated for it.
INFERRED: Module access device U[n]\G. Depends on the mounted module. No static range is validated for it.
INFERRED: SFC block device. Depends on the SFC program. Marked SLMP-incompatible in the FX5 table; not established for iQ-R. No static range is validated for it.
